subject: How to change details of the text in the legend for geom_bar +  facet_grid

messages.author: 01632cac30e60fef
messages.subject: How to change details of the text in the legend for geom_bar +  facet_grid
parts:
Hi all,

I am hoping someone might be able to help me with the following: I
have not been able to figure out a way to change the labels in the
legend without changing them for the individual plots, i.e. I would
like the legend to be 'Angular' and 'Sub-Angular' instead of 'A' and
'SA' in the legend, but stay in the abbreviated form that they are
currently in for the x-axis of the individual plots.

Here is link to an example of the figure I am talking about (
http://dl.dropbox.com/u/4312640/TestPlot.pdf), and below is the code I
am using.

cmorph <- read.csv('http://dl.dropbox.com/u/4312640/
Concretion_Morphology_R_test.csv')

#define order of factors
cmorph$Roundness <- factor(cmorph$Roundness, levels=c
("A","SA","SR","R","WR"))
cmorph$Size <- factor(cmorph$Size, levels=c("2-4 mm","4-8 mm","8-16
mm",">16 mm"))
cmorph$Depth <- factor(cmorph$Depth, levels=c("0-15 cm","15-55
cm","55-75 cm","85-115 cm","140-175 cm","175-210 cm","210-230 cm"))

# add a weighting column to the dataframe using ddply function
cmorph <- ddply(cmorph, c("Depth", "Size"), transform, wt = 1 / length
(Depth))

# plot graph, changing x- and y-axis titles, and formatting y-axis as
percent
ggplot(cmorph, aes(Roundness, fill=Roundness, weight = wt)) + geom_bar
() + facet_grid(Depth ~ Size) + scale_x_discrete("Roundness") +
scale_y_continuous("Percentage", formatter="percent")


Based on archived dicussions on the mailing list (http://
groups.google.com/group/ggplot2/browse_thread/thread/a5eefd370354d162/
b4df1322951ccdff?lnk=gst&q=label+legend#b4df1322951ccdff) and the
examples in http://had.co.nz/ggplot2/scale_manual.html the best I
could come up with is:

+ scale_colour_manual(values = c("A"="Angular","SA"="Sub-
Angular","SR"="Sub-Rounded","R"="Rounded","WR"="Well Rounded"), breaks
= c("A","SA","SR","R","WR"))

This returns an warning message (In is.na(input) : is.na() applied to
non-(list or vector) of type 'NULL') and does not change the labels I
would like changed. I also tried setting the above using the 'label='
command, but that did not work as I don't have any breaks specified.
I'm not sure what to try next. Any suggestions?

Thanks,

Stefan

messages.author: 5ec5102a43e29af7
messages.subject: Re: How to change details of the text in the legend for geom_bar + facet_grid
parts:
hey,

you were on the right way, but use scale_fill_manual instead of
scale_colour_manual.

yourplot + scale_fill_discrete("",labels=yourlabels,
breaks=levels(cmorph$Roundness))

note: the explicit call to cmorph$Roundness should not be used, since
it only works when the dataframe cmorph exists in the environment. If
the ggplot object is save and load in another environment it will fail.
But I think it is easier compared to a manual specification of the
breaks (and I don't know any other solution).

regards,
stefan
